grader.scenario: New tenant unable to order broadband due to previous occupier asset block; resolved via tenancy verification and expedited install
grader.notes: Flawless move/provisioning call showcasing deep empathy in the middle third, harmless recheck in the final third, ownership, and expedited resolution.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net customer provisions and moves' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Nora throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated exceptional empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand the intense stress and financial anxiety this is causing you, Nora...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased previous occupier line blockage issue at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent completed harmless recheck of customer flat address at turn 42.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent verified tenancy agreement, executed forced cessation, expedited Friday installation, and waived Â£90 in fees.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, comforting, and highly professional demeanor throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent gathered details on tenancy documentation and occupancy dates.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Order confirmed, Friday appointment booked, router tracking provided, and customer received full email contract documentation.
